about_short_description.short_description: Honey Homes is a home maintenance firm that offers house maintenance and related services.

product.name: Dedicated Handyman Service
product.description: A membership service providing a dedicated handyman who performs home maintenance and repairs for members on a regular basis.

product.name: Home Maintenance Membership
product.description: An annual or monthly subscription plan offering a set number of handyman service hours and access to home maintenance support.

product.name: Honey Homes Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application that allows members to add tasks, schedule handyman visits, track progress, and communicate with the Honey Homes team.

product.name: Specialty Vendor Coordination
product.description: Service coordination for specialized home repair or maintenance tasks that require expert vendors beyond the handyman’s scope.

product.name: Preventive Home Maintenance
product.description: Scheduled maintenance services for home appliances and systems to ensure proper functioning and longevity.
